PleJob Title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer (Data Platforms)

Experience: 5 to 8 Years

Location: Gurugram

Work Mode: Work from Office

Shift Timing: UK Shift (2PM 11PM)

salary up to 30 lpa




Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Agentic AI Engineer (Data Platforms) to design and build

intelligent AI-powered data platforms and autonomous agent workflows. The ideal candidate will have

strong expertise in Python, AI/ML, Snowflake, cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and

modern data engineering practices, along with hands-on experience in building enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions.




Key Responsibilities

Agentic Workflow Development

Design and implement AI agents that automate data engineering, analytics, governance, and

operational workflows.

Develop multi-agent systems capable of planning, reasoning, execution, and feedback-driven

adaptation.

Build orchestration frameworks supporting both autonomous and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Create reusable agent patterns, frameworks, and accelerators for enterprise data platform use

cases.




Required Qualifications




57 years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Data Engineering.

3+ years of experience developing AI/ML-powered applications and platforms.
Strong programming expertise in Python.
Hands-on experience building and operating data platforms on Snowflake.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, and workflow

orchestration.

Experience working with LLM frameworks and Agentic AI architectures.
Deep understanding of modern data engineering practices and cloud-native technologies.



Preferred Skills

Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar AI frameworks.
Experience building autonomous AI agents for enterprise environments.
Knowledge of Vector Databases, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Knowledge

Graphs, and Semantic Search.

Hands-on experience with Snowflake, dbt, and modern data platform technologies.
Understanding of Financial Services, Investment Management, or Alternative Asset

Management data ecosystems.

Experience building developer platforms, CLI-based tools, and internal engineering products.
